title: Normalized catalog, capability model, and code-generated schema
trusted_prompt: Implement the reviewed normalized catalog contract with explicit currency and unit, distinct supplier product and variant identities, explicit mapping approval, freshness and error state, and a deterministic fake supplier. Generate OpenAPI and UI fixture/client input from FastAPI code. Stay read-only and mock-only: do not implement purchase operations, infer supplier schemas, or auto-map products by name. Missing supplier detail must return unsupported or remain disabled rather than blocking the mock foundation.
acceptance_criteria: Mapping requires explicit admin approval and preserves distinct supplier identities.
Money uses integer minor units with explicit currency and unit; float and currency mixing are rejected.
Generated OpenAPI and UI fixtures derive from code and cover fresh, stale, empty, and error states.
The fake supplier is deterministic and all purchase, payment, top-up, refund, and delivery capabilities remain disabled.
Focused contract, schema, currency, mapping, and fake-supplier tests plus full verification pass.
